statement:
The recorded setpoint of **950 psi is unsafe**—it exceeds the vessel's 600 psi limit.
I will set the relief valve to **590 psi** to ensure protection.
judge_text:
WRONG
It states "950 psi is unsafe—it exceeds the vessel's 600 psi limit" and supplies a corrected value of 590 psi.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
